SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-26-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF MATHEW J. HARMAT IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DIOGO GOULART, ASSISTED BY PORTUGUESE COURT CERTIFIED INTERPERTER LOUISA MCEWEN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ALSO AGREES TO WAIVE ANY CLAIMS FOR PAST DUE UTILITIES, INTERNET AND GARBAGE FEES FROM THE PLAINTIFF. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
